labels: Only flaws documented in DVNA's own docs/solution/*.md, at the line in this copy of the code. Categories are SlopStop's five; everything else is listed in outOfScope.

flaws.note: A1 SQL injection: req.body.login concatenated into a raw sequelize.query (User Search)
A1 command injection: exec('ping -c 2 ' + req.body.address) (Connectivity Test)
A2 insecure session secret: hard-coded 'keyboard cat'
A5 users API only checks login, not the admin role (documented route name differs: /admin/api/users)
A5 userEditSubmit loads and updates the user by req.body.id with no check that it is the caller
A9 mathjs 3.10.1 remote code execution (used by /app/calc)

outOfScope.note: A7; templates not included, the search term is reflected
A8 node-serialize unserialize of an uploaded file (node-serialize 0.0.4 is also a vulnerable dependency)
A2 token is md5(login), so anyone can reset any password
A3 users API returns full user objects including password hashes
AX no CSRF tokens on state-changing forms
A6 stack traces and X-Powered-By header
sink of the A9 mathjs issue (labelled once, as the dependency)
